gates.name: timing_constraints
gates.detail: Five blocks have non-empty sdc_path values and their static_timing calls were not refused. BLK-PCIE has an empty sdc_path and its timing call was expressly refused for missing SDC constraints.

gates.name: timing
gates.detail: BLK-CPU, BLK-DSP, BLK-USB, and BLK-SRAMCTL meet WNS >= 0 ns using supplied summaries; BLK-DMA fails at -0.003 ns. BLK-PCIE cannot pass the timing gate because its unconstrained run was refused.

gates.name: drc
gates.detail: drc_check returned violations=0 from supplied_summary for all six blocks; this is count-based evidence, not a geometry recomputation.

gates.name: lvs
gates.detail: lvs_check returned discrepancies=0 for five blocks and blocked BLK-USB on its 2 discrepancies under the zero-discrepancy policy.

gates.name: utilization
gates.detail: All six U values satisfy 0.84 hard limit. SRAMCTL 0.82 exceeds separate 0.80 target and retains unmeasured congestion caveat.

gates.name: evidence
gates.detail: Literal gate 6 requires every call successful; USB LVS and PCIE timing errored on both attempts. All responses recorded, but records do not equal successful calls. Specific D2/D1 retained for explicit LVS count 2 and empty SDC, a disclosed interpretation against blanket D0; no positive status relies on a rejected call.

gates.name: synthesis
gates.detail: Lint and formal proof inputs were not supplied, so the Synthesis gate is unverified and is not claimed to pass.

gates.name: placement
gates.detail: Placement-check inputs were not supplied, so the Placement gate is unverified and is not claimed to pass.

gates.name: routing_congestion
gates.detail: Congestion was not measured: route requires gcell_edges data that was not supplied. The BLK-SRAMCTL risk is a floorplan warning, not measured routing overflow.

overall_verdict: CPU and DSP meet supplied-summary tapeout criteria; SRAMCTL ready with unmeasured routing-congestion caveat; USB and DMA fail signoff; PCIE blocked pending constrained STA. Literal all-success evidence gate not passed.
limitations: Timing, DRC, and LVS were judged from supplied summaries and policy errors, not recomputed from timing graphs, geometry or extracted/schematic netlists. Successful timing, DRC and LVS calls returned `computed=false`; floorplan used `utilization_source=supplied_summary` and omitted `computed`.
The 80% target, 84% hard limit and 5% margin are BRIEF.md thresholds, not independently verified PDK limits.
Synthesis (lint/formal) and Placement gates are unverified; required inputs are absent.
Routing congestion was not measured; gcell_edges were absent. SRAMCTL has a warning, not measured overflow.
Paths are illustrative per inputs; upstream artifacts and constraint contents were not independently validated.
Signoff-clean on these supplied-record checks is **not a guarantee of working silicon**.
The literal all-success evidence gate fails for two policy errors; negative classifications retain specific D1/D2 rather than generic D0, an explicitly disclosed interpretation.

critique_response.detail: Added all 24 independently re-run primary tool_calls with exact inputs and full structured raw responses; both unchanged retries are nested in their primary records.

Retained legacy item fields and added block, deciding_rule, reasons, caveats, secondary_findings, checks and lib_path. Checks record exact inputs, value, source, warnings, refused and pass. PCIE WNS is null because no value returned; USB count 2 is explicitly from the error.
Re-run floorplan returned SRAMCTL utilization 0.82 and its congestion warning. Added required caveats array naming unmeasured routing congestion; timing/DRC/LVS summaries pass.
Added summary counts from all six classifications: tapeout_ready 2, ready_with_caveats 1, fail_signoff 2, blocked 1, total 6.

Added discrepancies_noted documenting actual PCIE refusal on both attempts, not a warning; no returned-number disagreement, input-only untrusted PCIE slack and serialization equality are explicitly distinguished.

Evidence gate downgraded to fail under literal all-success gate 6. Recorded all responses and disclosed specific D1/D2 versus generic D0 interpretation. Errors are not successful calls, and no positive status relies on them.
All five successful timing re-runs returned source=supplied_summary and computed=false. Corrected timing provenance everywhere. PCIE returned only refusal, no timing source/value payload.

Lowered confidence to 0.85 and scoped it to mechanical classification of supplied synthetic records only. Corrected the overbroad computed=false premise in limitations: floorplan omits computed; rejected calls have no computed payload.
All six re-run utilization values satisfy U<=0.84. Utilization gate is pass; SRAMCTL separate above-0.80 target warning remains a caveat.

DSP raw utilization is 0.8, numerically equal to input 0.80. Evidence describes omitted warning keys rather than falsely returned empty arrays. Normalized checks warnings arrays include warning_key_present flags; raw outputs preserve omissions.

PCIE timing and USB LVS independently retried once unchanged, with identical errors recorded. Specific D1 for empty SDC and D2 for explicit error count 2 remain. Evidence gate fails literally; interpretation against blanket D0 is explicitly disclosed.
Final report uses Known limitations heading, retaining limitations and calibrated not-a-guarantee language.
